mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board_master ( board_type_code, board_name, use_comment_yn, use_yn, menu_id ) VALUES ( #{boardTypeCode}, #{boardName}, #{useCommentYn}, #{useYn}, #{menuId} )
mapper.select: SELECT board_id, board_type_code, board_name, use_comment_yn, use_yn, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by, deleted_yn, menu_id FROM board_master

SELECT m.board_id, m.board_type_code, m.board_name, m.use_comment_yn, m.use_yn, m.created_at, m.created_by, m.updated_at, m.updated_by, m.deleted_yn, m.menu_id, p.post_id, p.board_id AS p_board_id, p.writer_id, p.title, p.content, p.post_status_code, p.created_at AS p_created_at, p.created_by AS p_created_by, p.updated_at AS p_updated_at, p.updated_by AS p_updated_by, p.deleted_yn AS p_deleted_yn FROM board_master m LEFT JOIN board_post p ON m.board_id = p.board_id AND p.deleted_yn = false WHERE m.board_id = #{boardId}
mapper.update: UPDATE board_master SET board_type_code = #{boardTypeCode}, board_name = #{boardName}, use_comment_yn = #{useCommentYn}, use_yn = #{useYn} WHERE board_id = #{boardId}
UPDATE board_master SET deleted_yn = true WHERE board_id = #{boardId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board_post ( board_id, writer_id, title, content, post_status_code) VALUES ( #{boardId}, #{writerId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{postStatusCode} )
mapper.select: SELECT post_id, board_id, writer_id, title, content, post_status_code, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by, deleted_yn FROM board_post
SELECT post_id, board_id, writer_id, title, content, post_status_code, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by, deleted_yn FROM board_post WHERE board_id = #{boardId}
SELECT post_id, board_id, writer_id, title, content, post_status_code, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by, deleted_yn FROM board_post WHERE post_id = #{postId}
mapper.update: UPDATE board_post SET board_id = #{boardId}, writer_id = #{writerId}, title = #{title}, content = #{content}, post_status_code = #{postStatusCode}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE post_id = #{postId}
UPDATE board_post SET deleted_yn = true WHERE post_id = #{postId}
